integrity: New claim is the complete 240-code classification and two orbit structure. A size-six example and the size spectrum were published previously; no independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only six-symbol perfect codes of length four correcting exactly two subsequence deletions, at the previously known size-six minimum.
Neither an all-alphabet classification nor an independent priority determination is claimed.
title: Complete classification of minimum-size perfect six-symbol two-deletion codes
